DPES-753 slice 753.D status fixtures: provenance

Source
  Each *.status file is a hand-written input of fixed text, chosen to cover one rule of the
  shell open-decision fold. No input is copied from a live status log. Each *.<kind>.open
  file is the exact stdout of bin/fm-classify-lib.sh's status_open_decisions for that
  input and kind. Nothing in these files, and no expected value in the Rust tests, is
  computed by Rust.

Generation
  gen-status-fixtures.sh <worktree-root> [<bash-binary>] regenerates every file here. It is
  kept outside the repository, in the firstmate task data directory, so the repository
  carries no shell tooling. Generation sources bin/fm-classify-lib.sh and captures stdout
  byte for byte; a command substitution is never used to write an expected file.

Classifier
  file:    bin/fm-classify-lib.sh
  sha256:  9613809694c5682fa25756c4dccee4622e4b7ca77b9b303fe4dc557cd461b901
  commit:  0447ea222c9f8e327a98175ab3b10f2b5b5d38f6 (last commit touching the classifier)
  worktree HEAD at generation: 8afdb8179d389fca6732bedc46a02e6155280d8c
  shell:   GNU bash, version 5.3.20(1)-release (aarch64-apple-darwin25.6.0)

Kinds
  Each case runs with kind ship, scout, secondmate, and unknown. Kind decides whether a
  ship or scout done: or failed: line clears the open set; secondmate and unknown ignore it.

Checks
  Expected files hold the classifier's exact bytes. A non-empty expected file has no
  trailing newline, because status_open_decisions returns through a command substitution.
  An empty expected file means no decision is open.
